user.title: Recipe language
user.description:
**Unofficial** – not affiliated with Lidl, SilverCrest or Tecpal.

The language decides which recipes, shopping list and meal plan you see. Choose the one used on your machine.

login.title: Sign in with Lidl
login.description:
1. Open a new tab in Chrome, open the developer console (⌥⌘J on a Mac, Ctrl+Shift+J elsewhere) and tick *Preserve log* in its settings.
2. In that tab open the **[Lidl sign-in page]({login_url})** and sign in.
3. The page then appears to hang. The console shows *Failed to launch 'lidl-com.monsieur-cuisine.companion://login/prod?…'*. Copy that address and paste it below.

The address works once and only for a few minutes.

error.invalid_callback: No sign-in address was found in the pasted text.
error.state_mismatch: This address belongs to another sign-in. Use the link in this dialog.
error.invalid_auth: Lidl rejected the sign-in. Open the link again and repeat.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Monsieur Cuisine cloud. Open the link again and repeat.

abort.reauth_successful: Re-authentication successful – the connection is back.
abort.reauth_account_mismatch: This sign-in belongs to a different account. Please sign in with the same account that was set up originally.
